name: Cloud Browser Workspace
postStartCommand: HOST_DIR=$(docker inspect $(hostname) --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/workspaces"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null); DATA_PATH=${HOST_DIR:+$HOST_DIR/test-client/.chromium-data}; DATA_PATH=${DATA_PATH:-/workspaces/test-client/.chromium-data}; mkdir -p /workspaces/test-client/.chromium-data && (docker start chromium 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name=chromium -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Etc/UTC -e CHROME_CLI='https://discord.com/app https://www.instagram.com https://www.tiktok.com' -p 3000:3000 -p 3001:3001 -v "$DATA_PATH:/config" --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size='2gb' --restart unless-stopped lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest)
